claim: Compares folder contents, finds exact duplicate subfolders, and lists changed or one-sided files.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; assert the albums duplicate, changed receipt, and backup-only note

claim: Choosing Folder A alone finds exact duplicate subfolders inside that folder.
sandbox: synthetic local folder snapshot with two independent matching subfolders; assert one duplicate pair and no ancestor pair

claim: Folder names, contents, and hashes stay in the browser; there is no account, analytics, tracking, or third-party request.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; capture every request through load, reset, and result rendering and require same-origin only

claim: Works offline after the first visit, including the demo, legal pages, and the designed not-found page.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; install the service worker, go offline, reload and reset the sample, then open Privacy, Terms, and an unknown path

claim: Exports the comparison report as JSON or CSV.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; download both formats and assert duplicate and difference records

claim: Demo data uses separate storage, resets to the shipped sample, and is discarded when the visitor starts for real.
where: demo banner, privacy page, demo documentation
sandbox: seed a real report, enter /demo, reset, leave demo, and prove the real record is unchanged and the demo record is gone

claim: The latest real report is stored in the browser and restored after refresh.
sandbox: start at /demo, leave demo, import a valid report into real mode, reload, and assert the saved result is restored

claim: Mirrorbyte checks a copied folder before removing its original and leaves the original when verification fails.
sandbox: start at /demo, enter real mode with an in-memory directory picker, corrupt the copied bytes, and assert the original is not removed

claim: You can restore a moved folder by moving it from the holding folder back to its original location.
sandbox: start at /demo, complete a verified in-memory holding-folder move, move the held folder back, and assert its path and bytes are restored

claim: Mirrorbyte does not delete files from the holding folder.
sandbox: start at /demo, complete a verified in-memory holding-folder move, and assert the held folder remains while no holding-folder removal is called
